name: Asset Classification
summary: Classifies every asset by WHAT IT IS — Windows / Linux / macOS / IoT (by device type) / OT / Network / Virtual / Cloud / Unclassified — to close the asset-detection loop that stalls ownership. Uses the 'no software enum = not IoT' rule, overlays ownership + risk per class, turns the Unclassified bucket into a reason-tagged worklist, and writes gated Class:<type> tags.
